comment.body: Design approved — proceed to build the fix PR in the fork.

Thanks for the report! To confirm the root cause, could you attach the crash dump (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\PowerToys\...` or the Windows Error Reporting `.dmp`) from when ShortcutGuide.exe crashed on Win+number? That will let us verify the fix against the exact fault.

actions.note: Medium confidence — a dump confirms the AV path before we open a PR.
actions.label: Ask author for a crash dump

design.root_cause: App.xaml.cs key-up reads OverlayWindow.AppWindow.IsVisible off the native keyboard-hook thread while the overlay is closing -> access violation across the C++/WinRT boundary.
verify: With fix: app activates, guide hides, no crash/dump
Normal Win long-press/release still works; Esc / click-outside close
repro: Wait until the Win+number taskbar labels show
design.fix_plan: Track visibility with a UI-independent Volatile flag; keep CloseAnimated on the DispatcherQueue.
